_about: Earlier scores for the catalogue entries (catalogue.json), kept apart so the three judges score blind. Keys are catalogue ids; each record names its scale and the doc it comes from. "via" names the code the score was given to when it now lives inside another entry (e.g. I8 inside RM1). Entries with no record were never scored. The scales differ and are NOT comparable: attention.md 1-5 (attention only), modern.md 0-15, motion.md 0-12, CINEMATIC_GUIDE reviewer marks out of 10.
